findings.evidence: The instruction forms the active-set KKT system using G_i p=-d_i and fills b_J from that right-hand side, but the algorithm defines neither d_i nor b_J. Its prerequisite def-sqp-linearized-quadratic-subproblem states the inequality as g_i(x)+Dg_i(x)p<=0, which does not define d_i. The enumerated system's right-hand side is therefore unspecified. Define d_i (for example, d_i:=g_i(x)) and specify the corresponding b_J entries. The assigned consumer reaches this batch-85 draft through its dependency closure. No raw source digest was retained, so the observation cannot be bound to pre-reader or current bytes.
